title: Node and phase
statement:
The two lobes of a real p orbital are labeled + and −. What do those signs mean?

[_]{a}

explanations: The probability density is nonnegative on both sides.
Both lobes describe the same orbital.

hints: Squaring the magnitude removes the sign.
The nodal plane separates the two phases.
solution: The signs describe the wavefunction. Squaring the magnitude removes the sign. The nodal plane separates the two phases. The probability density is nonnegative on both sides.
